instruction:
You are a construction site safety engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-16 package for temporary fuel/chemical storage bunding, drainage isolation, fire mode, alarm load, and spill response.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. External hazardous-material storage, fire interface, alarm load, and construction inspection workflows shape the context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Source Objects

- Product: `SSC-16-LH-06`
- Storage layout: `STORE-16-LAYOUT-06`
- Fuel/chemical inventory: `INV-16-FUEL-06`
- Bund detail: `BUND-16-DETAIL-06`
- Fire/hazard note: `FIRE-16-NOTE-06`
- Monitoring/alarm load schedule: `ALARM-16-LOAD-06`
- Site safety memo: `MEMO-16-SAFETY-06`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Largest container | {{ largest_container_l }} L |
| Rainfall allowance | {{ rainfall_allowance_l }} L |
| Provided bund volume | {{ provided_bund_volume_l }} L |
| Fire growth alpha | {{ fire_growth_alpha_kw_s2 }} kW/s2 |
| Design fire time | {{ design_fire_time_s }} s |
| Provided visibility | {{ provided_visibility_m }} m |
| Required visibility | {{ required_visibility_m }} m |
| Horn count | {{ horn_count }} |
| Horn current | {{ horn_current_a }} A |
| Strobe count | {{ strobe_count }} |
| Strobe current | {{ strobe_current_a }} A |
| Panel current | {{ panel_current_a }} A |
| NAC supply capacity | {{ nac_supply_capacity_a }} A |
| Alarm load | {{ alarm_load_w }} W |
| Alarm runtime | {{ alarm_runtime_h }} h |
| Alarm battery capacity | {{ alarm_battery_capacity_kwh }} kWh |
| Isolated drains | {{ isolated_drain_count }} |
| Total drains | {{ total_drain_count }} |
| Allowed spill response time | {{ allowed_spill_response_min }} min |
| Planned spill response time | {{ planned_spill_response_min }} min |

## Required Checks

- Required bund volume equals largest container plus rainfall allowance for this source pack.
- Fire HRR equals alpha times design fire time squared.
- NAC current is the sum of horns, strobes, and panel current.
- Alarm battery energy covers the alarm load over the required runtime.
- Drain isolation fraction confirms every listed drain is isolated.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack, preserve the source object IDs above, and state whether the baseline checks pass.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable source-pack hardening, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "required_bund_volume_l": <numeric_value>,
  "bund_volume_margin_l": <numeric_value>,
  "fire_hrr_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "visibility_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "nac_current_a": <numeric_value>,
  "nac_headroom_a": <numeric_value>,
  "alarm_battery_required_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "alarm_battery_margin_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "drain_isolation_fraction": <numeric_value>,
  "spill_response_margin_min": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "temporary-fuel-chemical-bund-fire-interface-package"
description = "SSC-16 temporary fuel chemical bund and fire interface metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound temporary bund volume, fire HRR, visibility margin, NAC load, alarm battery, drain isolation, and spill response metrics from a deterministic SSC-16 task-owned source pack."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "site-safety"
standards = ["hazardous storage workflow", "fire interface workflow", "alarm load workflow"]
tags = ["mechanical", "construction", "bund", "fire", "alarm", "site-safety", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.largest_container_l]
type = "float"
unit = "L"
description = "INV-16-FUEL-06 largest temporary storage container"
min = 2500.0
max = 2500.0

[params.rainfall_allowance_l]
type = "float"
unit = "L"
description = "BUND-16-DETAIL-06 rainfall allowance"
min = 600.0
max = 600.0

[params.provided_bund_volume_l]
type = "float"
unit = "L"
description = "BUND-16-DETAIL-06 provided bund volume"
min = 3600.0
max = 3600.0

[params.fire_growth_alpha_kw_s2]
type = "float"
unit = "kW/s2"
description = "FIRE-16-NOTE-06 t-squared fire growth alpha"
min = 0.0469
max = 0.0469

[params.design_fire_time_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "FIRE-16-NOTE-06 design fire time"
min = 240.0
max = 240.0

[params.provided_visibility_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "FIRE-16-NOTE-06 provided site visibility"
min = 14.0
max = 14.0

[params.required_visibility_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "FIRE-16-NOTE-06 required visibility"
min = 10.0
max = 10.0

[params.horn_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "ALARM-16-LOAD-06 horn count"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.horn_current_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "ALARM-16-LOAD-06 horn current"
min = 0.075
max = 0.075

[params.strobe_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "ALARM-16-LOAD-06 strobe count"
min = 4.0
max = 4.0

[params.strobe_current_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "ALARM-16-LOAD-06 strobe current"
min = 0.11
max = 0.11

[params.panel_current_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "ALARM-16-LOAD-06 panel current"
min = 0.2
max = 0.2

[params.nac_supply_capacity_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "ALARM-16-LOAD-06 NAC supply capacity"
min = 2.0
max = 2.0

[params.alarm_load_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "ALARM-16-LOAD-06 alarm standby load"
min = 95.0
max = 95.0

[params.alarm_runtime_h]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "ALARM-16-LOAD-06 alarm runtime"
min = 24.0
max = 24.0

[params.alarm_battery_capacity_kwh]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh"
description = "ALARM-16-LOAD-06 alarm battery capacity"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.isolated_drain_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "BUND-16-DETAIL-06 isolated drain count"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.total_drain_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "BUND-16-DETAIL-06 total drain count"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.allowed_spill_response_min]
type = "float"
unit = "min"
description = "STORE-16-LAYOUT-06 allowed spill response time"
min = 30.0
max = 30.0

[params.planned_spill_response_min]
type = "float"
unit = "min"
description = "STORE-16-LAYOUT-06 planned spill response time"
min = 18.0
max = 18.0

[outputs.required_bund_volume_l]
description = "Required temporary bund volume"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.bund_volume_margin_l]
description = "Provided bund volume minus required bund volume"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.fire_hrr_kw]
description = "T-squared design fire heat release rate"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.visibility_margin_m]
description = "Provided visibility minus required visibility"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.nac_current_a]
description = "Total notification appliance circuit current"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.nac_headroom_a]
description = "NAC supply capacity minus current"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.alarm_battery_required_kwh]
description = "Alarm battery energy required"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.alarm_battery_margin_kwh]
description = "Alarm battery capacity minus required battery energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.drain_isolation_fraction]
description = "Fraction of drains isolated for temporary storage"
tolerance = 0.001

[outputs.spill_response_margin_min]
description = "Allowed spill response time minus planned response time"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when bund, visibility, alarm, drain, and response checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001
